'''Scruts''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who controlled a band of outlaws on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. Usually contracted by Edan II's planetary government as mercenaries and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], Scruts and his fellows turned to harassing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces when they arrived on Edan II during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
